description: This file provides test support utilities for WebSocket interactions within the Gateway component of an application. It includes mock implementations of WebSocket tasks, sessions, and relevant data generators to facilitate unit testing of WebSocket communications, including connection handling, message sending/receiving, and error simulation.

classes.name: GatewayTestWebSocketTask
classes.description: A mock WebSocket task supporting customizable send and receive hooks, with internal state management for testing WebSocket behaviors.

classes.name: GatewayTestWebSocketSession
classes.description: A mock WebSocket session that produces GatewayTestWebSocketTask instances, tracking creation and cancellation for testing purposes.

methods.name: connectChallengeData
methods.description: Generates a Data object containing a JSON formatted challenge message with a nonce.

methods.name: connectRequestID
methods.description: Extracts the request ID from a WebSocket message if it is a connect request.

methods.name: connectOkData
methods.description: Generates a Data object representing a successful connection response with a given ID.

methods.name: connectAuthFailureData
methods.description: Creates a Data object representing an authentication failure response, with optional additional info.

methods.name: requestID
methods.description: Extracts the request ID from a WebSocket message, if it is a request message.

methods.name: okResponseData
methods.description: Creates a Data object representing a successful response message with a given ID.
